$description: Breather brand tokens. Source of truth for every other file in this package. Colours follow the SE Health Brand Placemat 2026; values marked derived are tints or shades made to pass contrast.

se-red.role: The one hero colour: primary action, title rule, the key moment. Fill or 24px+ text only.

se-red-deep.role: Red text at any size. Hover for SE Red.

plum.role: Structure and words: headings, body text, sidebar, chart marks, icon buttons.

teal.role: Information fills: number tiles, privacy and money fills. White large text only.

teal-deep.role: Teal text and thin chart marks on the page background.

soft-sage.role: Positive and done: improved, value shown, completed.

page.role: Every page background. Never pure white.

logo-grey.role: Hairlines, input borders, decorative shapes. Never text.

text-grey.role: Secondary text on the page background only.

teal-tint.role: Privacy, waitlist and money family container.

white.role: Text on SE Red, Teal and Plum; input fields. Not a page or card background.

sidebar-active.role: Active nav wash inside the Plum sidebar.

sidebar-label.role: Group labels inside the Plum sidebar.

series.role: Household, companionship, personal care, other. All 4.3:1+ on the page.

family.role: Calibri is SE Health's corporate face; Carlito is its free metric-compatible match.

display.use: Page title, the big number on a stat card, the verdict word. One per card.

title.use: Card titles, list headings, the red kicker above a headline.

body.use: Paragraphs, table cells, form text. Max 70ch.

label.use: Stat labels, pills, buttons, nav items, captions, axis ticks.

type-floor.role: Nothing renders smaller. Readable text is 14px or more.

full.use: Buttons, pills, tags, tab triggers, icon chips

title-rule.role: SE Red rule under a page title

elevation.role: Flat. No shadows or gradients. Depth comes from tonal layering.

tooltip.$value: Hidden to protect privacy: fewer than 5 people.
